repository.name: dinhnguyenx Repo
repository.description: Carefully scoped jailbreak tweaks for modern rootless devices.

packages.name: CCShortcutLauncher
packages.description: Loads My Shortcuts into an ordered Control Center popup and runs the selected Shortcut in the background without opening the Shortcuts app.
packages.tested: Validated on iOS 16 with Dopamine. Requires CCSupport and PreferenceLoader.

changes: Added an ordered popup for launching cached My Shortcuts directly from Control Center.
Added manual catalog loading and popup list management in Settings.
Added native Shortcut glyph and color rendering in Settings and the Control Center popup.
Runs supported Shortcuts in the background without foregrounding the Shortcuts app.

packages.name: ZoneAODFix
packages.description: Keeps Zone's animated Sleep stage visible during Always-On Display instead of letting progress updates restore the Locked wallpaper.
packages.tested: Tested on iPhone 14 Pro · iOS 16.1 · Dopamine

changes: Consolidated Zone transition handling without changing the confirmed AOD fix.
Removed diagnostic-only parser hooks and reduced runtime logging.
Improved safe hook installation and retry handling.
Prevented Zone progress scrubbing from overwriting the Sleep wallpaper during AOD.
Restored the Locked transition when the display wakes.
